_comment: Business rules the Policy agent enforces. IDs are cited in customer replies and audit logs.

rules.R-1: A cash refund requires the item to have been returned and received at our warehouse.
rules.R-2: Refunds must be requested within the refund window (30 days by default) after the return is received.
rules.R-3: Change-of-mind returns are refunded as store credit, not as a cash refund.
rules.R-4: Refunds above the approval limit require approval by a human support lead before payment.
rules.R-5: Each order can be refunded at most once.
rules.I-1: Insurance claims require active shipping insurance on the order.
rules.I-2: A claim payout is capped at the lower of the item value and the coverage limit.
rules.I-3: Insurance claims must be filed within 60 days of delivery.
rules.I-4: Claim payouts above the approval limit require approval by a human claims lead.
rules.I-5: A claim can be filed once the parcel is delivered or declared lost, not while it is still in transit.
rules.T-1: A shipment flagged as an exception (lost or stuck) automatically opens an investigation ticket.
rules.S-1: Customers can only access and act on orders that belong to their own account.

faq.hours: Support is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm Eastern, and Saturday 9am to 5pm.
faq.contact: You can reach a human agent by replying 'agent' in this chat or emailing support@swiftparcel.example.
faq.refund_time: Approved refunds reach the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
faq.return_how: Start a return from Orders > Return Item in your account, print the label, and drop the parcel at any carrier location.
faq.insurance_what: Shipping insurance covers loss or damage in transit up to the coverage limit shown on your order.
